description: Pylônes HTB - Martinique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EDF Systèmes Energétiques Insulaires. This dataset represents the position of HTB towers on the entire power grid operated by EDF in Martinique. These data are published for information purposes only, EDF cannot guarantee their accuracy and completeness. Updates will be published regularly. Coverage: EDF Systèmes Energétiques Insulaires. The portal shows the English title as "Pylons HTB – Martinique" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EDF Systèmes Energétiques Insulaires. Its keywords include reseau, pylones, cartographie-des-reseaux, lignes, htb. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-10-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
